channel.title: Bay Area News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Bay Area News (nbcbayarea.com)

item.title: Federal officers arrest 2 people at San Francisco International Airport
item.description: Federal officers arrested two people at San Francisco International Airport Sunday night, according to officials.

item.title: Family faces 'rude' overbooked hotel, a $1,400 lesson for all travelers
item.description: A South Bay family says a big, brand-name hotel turned them away because it overbooked -- and that cost the family a pretty penny.

item.title: San Jose to host men's March Madness Sweet 16, Elite Eight games
item.description: SAP Center will host Sweet 16 and Elite Eight NCAA men's basketball tournament games on Thursday and Saturday.

item.title: ICE officers go to TSA checkpoints at Trump's direction, while long wait times at airports persist
item.description: More federal immigration officers are making their way to U.S. airports after President Trump said he’d deploy them to supplement the TSA during a government shutdown that has caused long lines at security checkpoints across the country.

item.title: Crews work to contain large truck fire in San Jose
item.description: Crews are responding Monday morning to a blaze on the back of a truck, according to the San Jose Fire Department.

item.title: San Jose day care co-owner found guilty in drowning deaths of toddlers
item.description: A San Jose day care co-owner has been found guilty in the 2023 drowning deaths of two toddlers.

item.title: Man arrested in connection with downtown San Jose double homicide
item.description: A man was arrested in connection with the murder of two men in downtown San Jose, police said Tuesday. The homicides were the city's second and third of 2026.

item.title: Oakland's interim police chief talks challenges, progress, future
item.description: Interim Oakland police Chief James Beere opened up about crime challenges, what’s changing inside the department and if he wants the job permanently.

item.title: Woman recounts fight to open prestigious San Francisco athletic clubs to women
item.description: Joe Rosato Jr. has the story of six women who opened the door for other women to prestigious athletic clubs in San Francisco.

item.title: AI-powered robot at SJC helps travelers find flights and answers questions
item.description: There is a new high-tech way to greet travelers coming into and flying out of the Silicon Valley.

item.title: Foster City declares State of Emergency following cyber attack
item.description: Foster City officials continue to investigate a cyber attack that prompted the city to declare a State of Emergency.

item.title: San Francisco public defender facing sanctions over workload stance
item.description: A judge has found San Francisco's public defender in contempt following a fight over staffing and case loads.

item.title: Lafayette homicide suspect used hatchet, charged with murder
item.description: A Butte County man has been charged with the alleged murder of a Lafayette resident, the Contra Costa County District Attorney's Office said Tuesday.

item.title: 1 dead in house fire in San Francisco's Portola neighborhood
item.description: The one-alarm fire occurred in the 500 block of Dwight Street and caused major damage to the interior of the home, the Fire Department said.

item.title: Man facing auto theft charges drove to court in another stolen car, police say
item.description: A California man who was scheduled to appear in court on an auto theft case was arrested Tuesday after arriving at the courthouse with another stolen car.
